text: Design checkpoint during recovery: ReportInputIdentity now binds invocation/source/universe definition+size/semantic/target dispositions+payloads/build/authority/artifacts/basis/request, but generic Id values themselves lack a canonical representation. Two AcquisitionAccount values can reuse an invocation and differ only in target IDs yet derive one input checksum. Honest closure appears to require a small public OutputTargetIdentity[-Id] typeclass returning a deterministic Checksum, with String instance, then context bounds on ReportInputIdentity.forReport/forProjection, StoryOutputResult.of, and codec decode. This is new public vocabulary, so I am not adding it without chief approval. Please approve that exact addition or state that InvocationId is the authoritative complete input identity and target IDs are intentionally excluded.
